Welcome.Title: Vitruvium
Welcome.reopen: Open again: Game Settings → Vitruvium welcome.
Welcome.name: VITRUVIUM
Welcome.tagline: A universal game system, a toolkit for creating tabletop role-playing games.
Welcome.step1: Character. In the Actors tab, create a “Player Character”. The GM creates their heroes and opponents as “GM Character”.
Welcome.step2: Level and characteristics. On the sheet, pick level 3, 6, 9 or 12; hover over it to see its description. The pips under a characteristic set its level from 1 to 3. The counters under the header show how many points are already spent.
Welcome.step3: Domains, attributes, property. Add them with the “Add” button on the matching tab or drag them from the item directory. Abilities are written in the domain sheet.
Welcome.step4: Check. Click a characteristic name. In the window, choose a domain, difficulty, advantages or hindrances, and spend inspiration if needed. The result goes to chat. The “Brief sheet” button in the header opens a character summary in a separate window.
Welcome.step5: GM. The megaphone button on the token controls posts a check request to chat; players roll right from the card. The GM can mark a failure as a partial success.
Welcome.step6: Inspiration. Stars on the sheet, no more than six. The GM grants them, checks spend them.
Welcome.step7: Dice. Only the special six-sided dice: /r 3dv in chat rolls three. The system rejects other dice. 3D dice come from the “Vitruvium: Dice” module together with Dice So Nice.
Welcome.rulesNote: The official Vitruvium rules are published in Russian; the compendium keeps the original text.
